name: HAIL, EMPEROR!
scope: Every answer is a Roman emperor or something one of them did.

clues.q: The emperor said to have fiddled while Rome burned
The emperor who made his horse Incitatus a priest
The emperor who walled off the north of Britain
The Stoic who wrote the Meditations in camp, on campaign
The emperor who split the empire four ways into the Tetrarchy

name: WALK LIKE A PHARAOH
scope: Every answer is an Egyptian pharaoh, god, site or object.

clues.q: The boy king whose almost untouched tomb Howard Carter opened in 1922
The jackal-headed god of mummification, who walks souls to the afterlife
The pharaoh who had the Great Pyramid of Giza built
The woman who ruled as pharaoh and raised a mortuary temple at Deir el-Bahari
The heretic who turned Egypt to the sun disc Aten and back again after him

name: GREEK THINKERS
scope: Every answer is a Greek philosopher, mathematician or their idea.

clues.q: The philosopher Athens sentenced to death, who drank the hemlock
The man whose theorem ties the three sides of a right triangle together
The tutor of Alexander the Great, who founded the Lyceum
The Syracusan who is supposed to have shouted Eureka in the bath
The Alexandrian whose Elements earned him the name father of geometry

name: THIS OLD CASTLE
scope: Every answer is a castle, a fortification or a part of one.

clues.q: The wide ditch round a castle, filled with water where it can be
The heavy iron grille that drops to shut the gateway
The strong central tower, and the last place left to fall back to
The open courtyard inside the outer wall
The jutting stonework at the wall top, with holes to drop things through

name: RENAISSANCE MEN
scope: Every answer is a Renaissance figure or one of their works.

clues.q: The polymath who painted the Mona Lisa and the Last Supper
The Florentine who cut a David out of one flawed block of marble
The Florentine diplomat who wrote The Prince
The Pole who put the Sun rather than the Earth at the middle of it all
The Dutch humanist behind the satire In Praise of Folly

name: SPIRIT OF '76
scope: Every answer is a person, battle or document of the American Revolution.

clues.q: The silversmith who rode out to Lexington with the warning
The man who did most of the writing of the Declaration of Independence
The American general whose name became a byword for treachery
The 1777 New York victory that brought France into the war
The Prussian baron who drilled the Continental Army at Valley Forge

name: BLUE & GRAY BATTLEGROUNDS
scope: Every answer is an American Civil War battle, general or place.

clues.q: The general who commanded the Army of Northern Virginia
The three days in Pennsylvania that turned the war
The Union general who marched to the sea through Georgia
The bloodiest single day in American military history, in Maryland in 1862
The Virginia village where the Army of Northern Virginia gave up in 1865

name: OVER THE TOP
scope: Every answer is a First World War battle, weapon, treaty or figure.

clues.q: The archduke shot at Sarajevo, and the war followed
The British liner a U-boat sank in 1915, with Americans aboard
The 1919 treaty that ended the war and sent Germany the bill
The ten-month fight the French summed up as they shall not pass
The intercepted German cable offering Mexico an alliance

name: BATTLE STATIONS
scope: Every answer is a Second World War battle, operation, leader or machine.

clues.q: The Japanese strike on an American naval base in December 1941
The codename for the Allied landings in Normandy
The 1942 sea fight where broken codes cost Japan four carriers
The siege on the Volga that turned the Eastern Front
The codename of the American project that built the atomic bomb

name: COLD WAR HOT SPOTS
scope: Every answer is a Cold War crisis, place, treaty or figure.

clues.q: The 1962 standoff over Soviet missiles ninety miles from Florida
The western alliance signed in 1949
The American money that rebuilt western Europe after 1948
The war that ended in an armistice and a demilitarised zone on the 38th parallel
The eastern alliance raised in 1955 to answer the western one
